name: @graphrefly/native
description: GraphReFly Rust substrate (napi-rs bindings) — preview. Async-surface Rust implementation of the GraphReFly dispatcher (Core runs on a tokio blocking pool; every Core-touching call is async). NOTE: this is NOT (yet) a drop-in substitute for @graphrefly/pure-ts — @graphrefly/graphrefly consumes a sync substrate API; redirecting the peer via npm overrides will not work. A sync/async public-contract reconciliation (D080) is deferred. Use @graphrefly/pure-ts for @graphrefly/graphrefly today.
comment_for_humans: @graphrefly/native is the napi-rs binding for the Rust GraphReFly dispatcher. package.json mirrors the napi-rs canonical layout (binaryName + per-target sub-packages; optionalDependencies are generated by `napi prepublish` in CI, not committed). FIRST PUBLISH 0.0.1 (preview): tag `native-v0.0.1` on graphrefly-rs triggers .github/workflows/native-npm-publish.yml (5-target build → per-platform sub-packages via `napi prepublish` → umbrella `npm publish --access public`). publishConfig.access=public makes the scoped sub-packages public on first publish too. Prereqs: NPM_TOKEN automation secret on the repo + @graphrefly npm org membership. This preview is the ASYNC Rust substrate; it is NOT a sync drop-in for @graphrefly/pure-ts (D080 reconciliation deferred — see graphrefly-ts archive/docs/SESSION-DS-native-substrate-contract.md).
